text: Figure 7.1: Pattern matching mechanism The Firewall interfaces with the LSduR to receive network packets. After inspection, the Firewall returns the network packet to LSduR if it is allowed to continue in the network stack or otherwise dropped by the Firewall. The FirewallRules are generally static, but the Firewall offers a mechanism to dynamically enable/disable FirewallRules during runtime: The Firewall is connected to the BswM, which switches the Firewall State to allow for dynamic firewall behavior based on the current vehicle state (e.g. driving, parking, in a diagnostic session). More details can be found in Section 7.4.3. Furthermore, the Firewall supports also the intrusion detection system by raising se- curity events.
